context: A teacher discusses war history research
purpose: Teach: 嘆く/本性/有様/人道的/勇敢/執念/スクープ/高学年

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、民の暮らしを、絶対、嘆く、絶対、声、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled civilian voices during wartime in your paper — I really admired it. Seriously impressive work.
lines.style: Warm, attentive, speaking with genuine recognition. Measured pace, comfortable silence between thoughts. A teacher acknowledging real effort with no performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。戦時に、本気で、絶対、人の本性、絶対、現れる、絶対、こと、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on how wartime reveals people's true nature in the paper. I'm really grateful for your feedback — it pushed my research deeper.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Earnest delivery with slight vulnerability — he's accepting praise without deflecting. Steady voice, careful word choice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、町の有様、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What impressed me was how you captured the state of the towns themselves. Your perspective was remarkably broad.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly leaning forward. Contemplative tone — she's reflecting genuinely, not just offering praise. Deliberate pacing, like she's remembering specific passages.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、人道的支援、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to examine humanitarian aid efforts during that period. It was demanding research, but your encouragement meant a lot.
lines.style: Quiet determination underlying the gratitude. Speaking carefully, as if choosing words that matter. Slight breath before 'demanding' — acknowledgment of the difficulty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、勇敢な、絶対、市民、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And you wrote about the ordinary citizens who resisted — that took real care to do well.
lines.style: Engaged, nodding slightly in her voice. Warm acknowledgment with a note of respect for the subject matter. Slower on 'resisted' — weight behind the word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、抵抗者の執念、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I spent a lot of time on the resistance fighters' determination — their resolve was the heart of the paper. Thank you for recognizing that depth.
lines.style: Focused, almost intent. Speaking with the quiet confidence of someone who knows what they worked on mattered. Direct but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の新聞のスクープ、本気で、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The newspaper accounts from that era — the way you incorporated them into your argument was really thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. She's seeing the paper again as she speaks. Slight pause before 'thoughtful' — genuine consideration, not rote feedback.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時の高学年児童、本気で、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I examined how wartime education affected older children specifically. It was intricate work, and I'm deeply grateful for your support throughout.
lines.style: Measured, closing with quiet sincerity. He's summing up — not rushing, but landing the gratitude with precision. Slight fadeout at the end, as if the conversation has reached its natural depth.
